literal_meaning: খটখটে বা নোংরা শব্দসূচক (onomatopoeic term suggesting grittiness or dirtiness)
figurative_meaning_en: A special slur directed at people with filthy or unclean habits
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এমন খটাশ যে তার ঘরে ঢুকতেই ঘেন্না হয়।
খটাশটাকে আর কাছে ঘেঁষিস না, নোংরা!
example_sentences_in_english: He's such a filthy slob that entering his room makes you nauseous.
Don't go near that dirty pig; he's disgusting!
note: This is a dialectal slang term, possibly from rural or semi-urban Bengali dialects, used informally to demean unclean individuals.
